questions.q: In a certain code language, ‘What you think you become’ is written as ‘Fe Mo Su Ta Za’ and ‘What you think you achieve’ is written as ‘Mo Su Te Fe Za’. How will ‘achieve’ be written in that language?
questions.s:
The correct answer is: b

  1. The first phrase "What you think you become" corresponds to the code "Fe Mo Su Ta Za".
  2. The second phrase "What you think you achieve" corresponds to the code "Mo Su Te Fe Za".

Notice that the words "What you think you" are common in both phrases and their codes ("Mo Su Fe Za").

The only word different in the second phrase is "achieve," which corresponds to "Te" in the code "Mo Su Te Fe Za".

Therefore, "achieve" is written as Te in that code language.

SSC CHSL 30/05/2022 (Evening)

Logic : Each Vowel is replaced by its place value in alphabet, while each consonant is replaced by (Place value × 2).

GUEST ⇒ 7-21-5-19-20 ⇒ (7 × 2)-21-5-(19 × 2)-(20 × 2) = 14-21-5-38-40

questions.s:

Drinking is dangerous addiction – nap tap cap vap …….. (2)

In a certain code language, 'trip around a lake' is written as 'T R Q M' and 'view from the lake' is written as 'S V M P' and 'location from trip' is written as 'V G Q' and 'view like a world' is written as 'O S T Z'. How is 'around' written in the given language?

एक निश्चित कोड भाषा में, 'trip around a lake' को 'T R Q M' लिखा जाता है और 'view from the lake' को 'S V M P' लिखा जाता है और 'location from trip' को 'V G Q' लिखा जाता है और 'view like a world' को 'O S T Z' लिखा जाता है। दी गई भाषा में 'around' को कैसे लिखा जाएगा?

It is given that,

'trip around a lake' is written as 'T R Q M' ------(I)

'view from the lake' is written as 'S V M P' ------(II)

'location from trip' is written as 'V G Q' -------(III)

'view like a world' is written as 'O S T Z' ------(IV)

From I and II, 'lake' is coded as M.

Thus, the word 'around' is coded as R.
